verdict.rationale: Browserbase clearly provides managed remote browser sessions that can be created, controlled and observed via API (browserbase-docs-1, browserbase-docs-4), and a CLI/skill integration exists (browserbase-probe-4) that could support manual, interactive use. However, the evidence is overwhelmingly focused on programmatic/agent-driven automation rather than a human-in-the-loop, manual browsing experience (e.g., a live-view iframe or interactive debugger), which is never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a live/interactive session viewer for manual human browsing, and independent corroboration that developers actually use it for hands-on manual sessions rather than purely automated agent tasks.
